assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one production key-pose sprite for the adult Stolas human-disguise costume in a side-on 2D fighting game. One character, one pose, no sprite sheet.
Input images: Image 1 is the recovered crouching sprite; Image 2 is the recovered jumping sprite. Both are mandatory visual identity and costume references. Preserve exactly their adult human character identity, face, pointed chin, red eyes, swept dark gray hair with a white front streak, circular red goggles with thin gold rims resting above the forehead, long burgundy sleeveless waistcoat with split tails and small gold buttons, gray long sleeves, white layered cravat, black trousers and pointed black boots. Human anatomy only; no owl beak, feathers, wings or horns.
Primary request: produce the new pose described below, facing RIGHT in the same side/three-quarter orientation as both references. Keep the same crisp black linework, flat cel shading, palette and slim elongated adult proportions. This is a new game adaptation, not a claim of reproducing an official episode frame.
Composition: landscape canvas exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels, matching the references. Full body including hair tips, goggles, hands, coat tails and boot tips entirely visible with clear margin. Head size and limb thickness must match the references. For grounded poses place the sole contact baseline at y=975, and the central ground pivot at x=768. Do not shrink the character to fit a tiny area. Do not add a floor.
Background: true transparent RGBA, clean alpha around the whole silhouette, all clothes and skin opaque. Remove the diffuse gray glow seen around the references; no aura or vignette.
Avoid: extra character, second view, grid, panel, text, logo, backdrop, ground shadow, smoke, magic effects, motion trails, added accessories, changed clothing, realism or 3D.
Pose: A standing combat-ready guard. Stand tall with knees very slightly flexed, both boots planted in a balanced staggered stance, front hand loosely open near upper chest and other hand slightly forward near waist. Calm attentive expression looking right. Keep the tall slender silhouette and long coat tails hanging naturally. This is a neutral ready pose, clearly different from crouching and jumping.
